title: Modular radius and hierarchy update for buttons, tables, and charts
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: introduce a modular radius and visual hierarchy approach that reconciles dense data surfaces (tables, compact cards) with touch-friendly interactive elements (buttons, menus) by shipping a small set of canonical radius and elevation tokens, an adjusted typography scale for density, and updated chart palettes for improved perceptual separability.

Background: Over the last two quarters we accumulated ad-hoc corner radii and shadow recipes across components. This causes inconsistent micro-interactions, layout jitter when swapping variants, and extra engineering work to maintain exceptions. At the same time product teams want a denser table and chart presentation for admin/UIs while keeping our public-facing flows comfortable. This ticket scopes a set of token changes and component adaptation patterns to unify those needs with minimal surface area change to existing apps.

Scope:
- Define a 5-step radius system (r-0, r-1, r-2, r-3, r-4) mapped to physical pixels and CSS vars.
- Simplify elevation into three semantic layers (flat, raised, floating) and provide updated shadow tokens tuned for dark and light modes.
- Introduce two density variants for components: default and compact (prefers r-1 and tighter spacing).
- Adjust typography scale with a fluid small-scale option for compact tables and dense cards.
- Refresh primary chart palette with color-blind–safe swatches and reserve semantic tokens for states (success/warn/error/info).
- Produce migration guide and codemods to help teams swap to new tokens with minimal regressions.

Non-goals: full color system redesign, reworking every existing component—this ticket is focused on tokens and the highest-impact components (buttons, table rows, charts, and primary form controls).
acceptance_criteria: All new radius and elevation tokens defined in the design tokens file and exposed as CSS variables.
Button, TableRow, Card, and Chart components support density variant and map to new tokens.
Visual QA screenshots for light and dark modes across default and compact density for the four components.
Accessibility report showing color contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text and at least 3:1 for UI controls in compact mode where applicable.
Migration guide and example codemod PR merged to component library repository.
Performance: no >5% regression in style recalculation on representative pages after token swap (measured in staging).
